entries.26c2f069246f2173: The group consists of the company and 1 subsidiary (Lifenet Mirai Inc.), and the [[term:segment|segment]] is only 1, the life insurance business. The company is a life insurance company that receives monthly insurance premiums from customers and pays insurance claims and benefits to prepare for death, illness and other events, places its sales window on the Internet, and curbs personnel expenses for sales staff and expenses for maintaining stores (selling expenses). The consolidated financial statements are prepared under [[term:ifrs|IFRS]], and the top line of the consolidated statement of profit or loss is "insurance revenue." Insurance revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥34,388 million (¥30,081 million in the previous fiscal year), with a breakdown of individual insurance ¥26,370 million and group credit life insurance ¥8,018 million. Profit before tax, which is insurance service profit of ¥11,606 million plus financial profit of ¥266 million and other profit and loss of -¥483 million, was ¥11,389 million, and profit for the year attributable to owners of parent was ¥8,041 million.

entries.aee24cfdc79e1b11: A life insurance company whose main sales channel is the internet. The group consists of the company and one [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiary]] (Lifenet Mirai Co., Ltd.; voting rights held 91.1%; insurance agency business and service development business), and as of March 31, 2026, it had 242 employees. Its management philosophy is 'Operate honestly, and support each customer's way of life by providing products and services that are easy to understand, inexpensive and convenient,' and since opening in 2008 it has adopted the 'Lifenet Life Insurance Manifesto.' At its board meeting on May 29, 2026, the company resolved to tender all of its common shares in Lifenet Mirai Co., Ltd. in a share buyback by that company; with the execution of the acquisition, Lifenet Mirai is scheduled to be excluded from consolidated subsidiaries.
entries.af34a5d8663a67b6: The insurance service result for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,606 million (¥9,576 million in the previous fiscal year), a figure that reflects insurance service expenses of ¥21,393 million and a reinsurance result of -¥1,388 million. The annual securities report cites as reasons for the increase that actual insurance claims incurred in individual insurance were lower than expected claims, and an increase in profit related to group credit life insurance. Adding a financial result of ¥266 million, mainly from higher interest income on bonds whose holdings were increased, and other profit or loss of -¥483 million gives profit before tax of ¥11,389 million. Profit for the year was ¥8,040 million, of which ¥8,041 million was attributable to owners of the parent and -¥1 million to non-controlling interests. Insurance acquisition cash flows, the costs directly attributable to acquiring insurance contracts, were ¥10,458 million. The 'comprehensive capital' that the company uses as a management indicator (IFRS equity plus CSM and the value of group credit life contracts) was ¥176,149 million at the end of March 2026.
entries.b0bba2a361904495: This business delivers simple insurance without complex special riders to individual customers through the internet. There are two sales channels: the “Direct Business,” through which customers apply via the company’s website and other channels, and the “Partner Business,” through which customers apply via the websites and apps of partner companies. Under the Partner Business, the company sells “au no Seimei Hoken” with KDDI Corporation (since April 2016), “Money Forward no Seimei Hoken” with Money Forward, Inc. (now Money Forward Home, Inc.) (since July 2021), and “V Point ga Tamaru Hoken” with Mitsui Sumitomo Card Co., Ltd. (since December 2023). Insurance revenue from individual insurance for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥26,370 million, and the number of policies in force at the end of March 2026 was 686,237.

entries.becad34b19f0b10d: The group consists of the company and one subsidiary, Raifunetto Mirai Co., Ltd., and is a single-segment life insurance business. The company is a life insurance company whose main sales channel is the internet, and it engages in (1) insurance underwriting (underwriting and reinsurance of insurance that prepares for survival, death, illness or injury), (2) asset management (investment of premiums and other funds received), and (3) agency and administrative services for other insurance companies. Its subsidiary, Raifunetto Mirai Co., Ltd., operates an insurance agency business and a service development business, but on May 29, 2026, the company's board of directors resolved to tender all of its ordinary shares in the acquisition of treasury shares by that company. Upon execution of this acquisition, it is scheduled to be excluded from consolidated subsidiaries.
